doom.pow: Genius intellect, sorcery, armored tech, absolute will
doom.bio: Monarch of Latveria, scientist AND sorcerer — convinced the world would be better under his rule. The greatest villain Marvel ever wrote, now played by the face of the MCU itself.

tony.pow: Genius, billionaire, playboy, philanthropist — plus the armor
tony.bio: The man who opened the MCU and ended what Thanos started with a single snap. His death in Endgame is the emotional ground zero that makes RDJ's return as Doom hit so hard.

steve.pow: Super soldier, indestructible shield, unbendable morals
steve.bio: The first Avenger — passed the shield to Sam Wilson and stayed in the past. Evans is confirmed for Doomsday, his role is not: Steve? Johnny Storm? Nobody knows.

sam.pow: Vibranium wings, the shield, tactics — no serum
sam.bio: The Cap without superpowers. Likely leads one of the factions in Doomsday — in open rivalry with Yelena's New Avengers over the Avengers name.

bucky.pow: Super soldier, vibranium arm, 70 years of combat experience
bucky.bio: Hydra's assassin, Steve's best friend, now a congressman and New Avenger. One of the few characters present continuously since 2011.

thor.pow: God of thunder, Stormbreaker, ~1,500 years of experience
thor.bio: The last active founding Avenger. In the SDCC footage Doom stops his Stormbreaker with one hand — Thor's role in Doomsday should be central and painful.

loki.pow: Magic, shapeshifting — and now: holding all timelines together
loki.bio: From villain to God of Stories: Loki holds the entire multiverse together at the end of time like a living tree. The most obvious target for Doom — and the saga's biggest open Chekhov's gun.

wanda.pow: Chaos magic, reality rewriting — a Nexus being
wanda.bio: Created her own reality out of grief, wiped out the Illuminati on Earth-838 and 'died' under a mountain — very vaguely. Her son Billy lives on as Wiccan.

vision.pow: Synthezoid: density control, flight, Mind-Stone legacy
vision.bio: Died twice, rebuilt once in white: White Vision searches for his identity in Vision Quest — and meets the voice of his creator, Ultron (James Spader).

strange.pow: Master of the mystic arts, Time-Stone veteran, multiverse traveler
strange.bio: Saw 14 million futures, cracked the multiverse open for a teenager and dreamwalked through corpses. Has a third eye since MoM — and owes the multiverse an incursion repair.

spidey.bio: The world forgot he exists. In Brand New Day (in theaters since 07/31/2026) he rebuilds alone — before Doomsday presumably collects him too.

yelena.pow: Red Room training, dry humor as a weapon
yelena.bio: Natasha's sister, unofficial leader of the New Avengers — and the secret heart of the post-Endgame era. Leads the team standing on the front line in Doomsday.

natasha.bio: Sacrificed herself on Vormir for the Soul Stone. In a multiverse no death is final — a Widow variant is among the most anticipated Doomsday rumors.

shuri.pow: Genius intellect, heart-shaped herb, vibranium suit
shuri.bio: Took up mantle and burden after T'Challa's death. In Doomsday Wakanda stands between the fronts — and SDCC revealed yet another, new Black Panther.

sentry.pow: The power of a thousand exploding suns — and its shadow
sentry.bio: The most powerful and most unstable being in the MCU: his dark self, the Void, swallowed half of New York. The only hero-side figure on Doom's level — if he holds.

deadpool.pow: Healing factor, fourth-wall breaks, katana chaos
deadpool.bio: Saved his dying timeline by delivering the TVA a new anchor being: Wolverine. Marvel's 'Jesus', as he calls himself — a Doomsday appearance is considered certain, confirmed is nothing.

wolverine.pow: Adamantium skeleton, healing factor, 200 years of rage
wolverine.bio: The 'worst Wolverine of his world' who found redemption. His universe hangs on him as its anchor being. Officially not in the Doomsday cast — nobody believes that.

xavier.bio: Founder of the X-Men, dreamer of coexistence. Killed by Wanda on Earth-838; in Doomsday Stewart returns once more — which Xavier it is, nobody knows.

magneto.bio: Holocaust survivor, mutant radical, Xavier's mirror image. McKellen's return after more than a decade is one of Doomsday's biggest sensations.

reed.pow: Elastic body, smartest man of his world
reed.bio: Saved his Earth from Galactus — and lost his son to Doom four years later. In the comics, Reed is the only one who truly beats Doom in the end.

sue.pow: Invisibility, force fields — strongest of the four
sue.bio: Gave birth to Franklin in orbit and stopped Galactus with sheer willpower. The mother whose child Doom has taken: underestimate her at your peril.

franklin.pow: Can (in the comics) create entire universes
franklin.bio: Galactus wanted him, Doom has him: in the comics Franklin's omega-level power keeps Doom's Battleworld alive. Probably the most important MacGuffin of the whole saga — and he is four.

venom.pow: Symbiote: strength, tentacles, appetite for heads
venom.bio: A journalist with an alien roommate. Slipped briefly into the MCU in Let There Be Carnage and left a piece of symbiote behind — an open thread nobody has picked up.

thanos.pow: Titan physique, Infinity Stones, iron conviction
thanos.bio: Erased half of all life and was erased twice himself. The benchmark Doom is measured against — and, according to the comics, merely his warm-up act.

kang.bio: The planned saga endgame whose story was never finished. The Council of Kangs is theoretically still waiting — in the comics it is Doom who ends such chaos.

hulk.pow: Limitless strength through rage — now with Banner's mind
hulk.bio: From curse to fusion: since Endgame, Banner and Hulk are one person. Most recently he tore up Peter's streets in Brand New Day — his son Skaar has already shown up too.

clint.bio: The family man among the Avengers, briefly the vengeful Ronin. Passed bow and responsibility to Kate Bishop.

kamala.pow: Light constructs — and the MCU's first confirmed mutation
kamala.bio: Jersey City's biggest fangirl superhero and the quiet engine of the Young Avengers: at the end of The Marvels she starts recruiting her team.

carol.bio: One of the strongest figures in the MCU — and one of the loneliest. After The Marvels her friend Monica is stuck in a foreign universe: a direct X-Men bridge.

tchalla.bio: King of Wakanda, heart of a cinematic era. After Chadwick Boseman's death the role was not recast — Shuri carries his legacy.

namor.pow: Mutant: flight, amphibious physique, centuries old
namor.bio: Ruler of the underwater realm Talokan and the first in the MCU to call himself a 'mutant'. Back in Doomsday — on which side is open.

redguardian.bio: Russia's answer to Captain America — loud, proud, warmer than he admits. The foster father who holds Yelena's New Avengers together.

usagent.pow: Serum soldier with a control problem
usagent.bio: The Captain America who failed — and got a second chance as U.S. Agent. Walking proof that the shield weighs more than it looks.

valentina.bio: Spent years quietly collecting antiheroes and nearly caused the apocalypse with the Sentry project. Nick Fury's dark mirror.

wiccan.pow: Reality and chaos magic — Wanda's legacy
wiccan.bio: Wanda's believed-dead son, reborn in the body of Billy Kaplan. One of the most powerful magicians of the new generation — the Young Avengers are practically assembled.

agatha.pow: Centuries-old witch, steals other people's magic
agatha.bio: Stole her coven's magic in 1693 and nearly stole Wanda's show. Ended the Witches' Road as a ghost at Billy's side — 'Agatha All Along' became a Grammy meme anyway.

galactus.bio: Older than the universe, eternally hungry. Wanted Franklin as his successor and got shoved through a portal by Sue Storm — humiliated, not defeated.

mephisto.pow: Marvel's devil: contracts, temptation, a dimension of torment
mephisto.bio: Written into every fan theory since WandaVision — real since Ironheart. His first deal is already running; who else has signed, nobody knows.

miles.pow: Spider powers plus venom blast and invisibility
miles.bio: The Spider-Man who proved anyone can wear the mask. After Across the Spider-Verse he stands against the entire Spider Society — part three keeps us waiting.

cyclops.pow: Optic energy blasts, born field commander
cyclops.bio: Xavier's first student and eternally underrated leader — disposed of unworthily twice in the Fox films. Marsden's Doomsday return is late justice.

jean.pow: Telepathy & telekinesis — omega level with a Phoenix problem
jean.bio: Filmed twice, consumed by the Phoenix Force twice. The most powerful and most tragic figure of the X-Men saga.

storm.pow: Command over the weather — omega level
storm.bio: Weather goddess, teacher, later headmistress. In the comics briefly Queen of Wakanda — a connection the movies never told.

beast.pow: Genius intellect in a predator's body
beast.bio: Scientist, diplomat, blue fur. Grammer's surprise cameo in The Marvels made him the first Fox figure in MCU canon — Doomsday follows.

mystique.bio: Magneto's deadliest weapon and Xavier's lost foster sister — depending on the timeline. Romijn's return in Doomsday brings back the iconic version.

gambit.pow: Charges objects with kinetic energy — cards preferred
gambit.bio: Twenty years of development hell, then the debut in the Void: Tatum's Gambit became the crowd favorite of D&W — and finally gets his stage in Doomsday.

scott.bio: The ex-thief whose Quantum Realm accident made Endgame possible — and the first to beat Kang. The most underrated résumé in the MCU, and he is in the Doomsday cast.

cassie.pow: Her own Pym suit, science talent
cassie.bio: Grew up five years without her father between Snap and Blip and secretly built quantum satellites. In Doomsday — the Young Avengers bench is filling up.

quill.pow: Ex-half-Celestial, blasters, impeccable taste in music
quill.bio: Led the Guardians through three films and one fatal tantrum on Titan. Living back on Earth since Vol. 3 — 'Star-Lord will return', the credits promised.

rocket.pow: Genius for weapons, locks and sarcasm
rocket.bio: From lab experiment to captain of the Guardians — Vol. 3 told his story and broke an entire audience. Not a raccoon.

nick.pow: Espionage, paranoia, always a plan B
nick.bio: The man who invented the Avengers Initiative — in the very first MCU post-credit scene. Bruised after Secret Invasion, but nobody believes he is done.

monica.pow: Sees and absorbs the entire energy spectrum
monica.bio: Flew through Wanda's hex and became superhuman. Sacrificed herself in The Marvels — and woke up in an X-Men universe, next to Beast. The living bridge to Doomsday.

kate.pow: Best archer of her generation, chaotic energy
kate.bio: Saved Clint's Christmas and inherited the Hawkeye mantle. Kamala has already recruited her — the Young Avengers have long been in the making.

america.pow: The only person in the multiverse who can physically travel between universes
america.bio: Was chased across half the multiverse by Wanda because her power cannot be copied. Strategically perhaps the most valuable figure of the whole saga — Doom surely knows.

mbaku.bio: From challenger to Wakanda's moral compass. Reached for the throne at the end of Wakanda Forever — in Doomsday he stands for Wakanda's hard edge.

daredevil.pow: Radar senses, lawyer by day, devil by night
daredevil.bio: The blind attorney who deals out at night what the law cannot deliver. Born Again put him back in the ring against Mayor Fisk — street-level Marvel at its best.

kingpin.pow: Brutal strength, an empire, political power
kingpin.bio: From underworld king to Mayor of New York — Fisk found the legal road to power and is more dangerous than ever.

punisher.pow: One-man war: tactics, weapons, no way back
punisher.bio: Marvel's most controversial figure: no hero, no mercy. After Born Again he now tears up Peter's neighborhood in Brand New Day — moral conflict guaranteed.

johnny.bio: The hothead of the Fantastic Four, noticeably more thoughtful than his Fox predecessors. Fun fact: his predecessor in blue was Chris Evans — whose Doomsday role is still secret.

ben.bio: Pilot, best friend, rock in every storm — literally. The heart of the Fantastic Four and their strongest fist when Doom comes knocking.

nightcrawler.bio: The devout teleporter with the devil's look; his White House scene in X2 remains one of the best X-Men sequences ever. Cumming returns after 23 years for Doomsday.

cassandra.pow: Telepathy on Xavier's level, without his conscience
cassandra.bio: Xavier's evil twin sister, ruler of the Void. Put her fingers literally inside other people's heads — and could resurface any time in the multiverse chaos.

gwen.bio: The Gwen who got bitten while her Peter died. Founded her own crew at the end of Across the Spider-Verse to save Miles.

goblin.pow: Goblin serum, glider, pumpkin bombs, two faces
goblin.bio: The genre's first great movie villain — and 19 years later, in No Way Home, more terrifying still: he took Aunt May from Peter there. Dafoe insisted on his own stunts.

hope.pow: Pym suit with wings and blasters — 'the one who should have done it from the start'
hope.bio: Bearer of the Wasp suit and the competent half of the Ant-Man duo. Rescued her mother from the Quantum Realm and faced Kang.

hank.bio: The original Cold-War Ant-Man whose particles made Endgame's time travel possible. Distrustful of anything named Stark.

janet.bio: Survived three decades in the Quantum Realm — and told no one she knew Kang there. Her secret set off Quantumania.
